ticket.title: Preserve existing location attributes while searching
ticket.text:
Preserve existing location attributes while searching

## Impact

Searching for a location while editing a patient can accidentally delete the patient’s existing location person attribute.

## Affected code

- `packages/esm-patient-registration-app/src/patient-registration/field/person-attributes/location-person-attribute-field.component.tsx`
- `packages/esm-patient-registration-app/src/patient-registration/field/person-attributes/location-person-attribute-field.resource.tsx`
- `packages/esm-patient-registration-app/src/patient-registration/form-manager.ts`

## Root cause

The location picker loads only ten locations when there is no search query. If the patient’s saved location is not in those results, the field appears blank.

Typing text that does not match a loaded option immediately sets the Formik value to `null`. The save path treats that value as an instruction to delete the existing attribute.

Explicitly clearing the ComboBox does not currently clear the Formik value, so supporting deliberate removal will be new behavior.

## Reproduction

1. Edit a patient whose location attribute is not among the first ten locations returned.
2. Confirm that the location field appears blank.
3. Type in the location search field without selecting another location.
4. Save and reload the patient.
5. The original location attribute is missing.

## Expected behavior

The saved location should be displayed. Searching should not change the stored value until the user selects another location or explicitly clears the field.

## Implementation direction

Include the patient’s saved location in the available options even when it is outside the initial result page.

Keep search text separate from the Formik value. Update the value only when the user selects another location or explicitly clears the ComboBox.

## Acceptance criteria

- A saved location outside the first result page is displayed.
- Typing without selecting another location preserves the saved value.
- Selecting another location updates the value.
- Explicitly clearing the ComboBox removes the attribute.
- Add interaction tests for display, search, selection, and explicit clearing.

Verified against `openmrs-esm-patient-management` commit `c64fb336`.
